name: FXMacroData Research
description: Research macroeconomic indicators, release calendars, FX reference data, positioning, commodities and scenario tools with FXMacroData. Use daily_briefing for a public USD overview or choose a named REST/MCP operation. Dates and source links are preserved.
author: FXMacroData

input.hint: public (default), or environment to use FXMD_API_KEY from the host secret environment. Never enter an API key here.

examples.prompt: Give me the latest USD macroeconomic briefing and upcoming releases.
Find USD macroeconomic indicators available for research.

operation.description: A named FXMacroData operation, or daily_briefing for public USD.
